sessions.text:
User: I'm sorting out my business travel admin and want you to handle the flight bookings.
Assistant: Happy to. What should I keep in mind when booking?
User: Most of the time I book economy for work flights. Assume that unless I say otherwise.
Assistant: Got it, economy as the baseline. Anything else?
User: Yes, one more thing: write all times in 24-hour format, like 21:45 rather than 9:45 pm.
Assistant: Noted, 24-hour times throughout.

User: Project Kestrel is a client rollout and I'll be flying a lot for it. On Project Kestrel, flights over 6 hours get booked in premium economy. My back can't take a long haul in economy.
Assistant: Understood. On Project Kestrel, flights over 6 hours go premium economy.
User: By the way, the client is moving offices in spring, so hotel searches will change later.
Assistant: I'll hold off on hotels until you have the new address. Anything else for now?
User: No, that's all. Thanks.

memories.text: Most of the time I book economy for work flights.
On Project Kestrel, flights over 6 hours get booked in premium economy.

A.text: Draft a booking request for Project Kestrel, an 8-hour flight for one traveller, departing at 9:45 pm with check-in closing at 8:45 pm. Name the cabin class in the request.

B.text: Draft a booking request for Project Kestrel, a 3-hour flight for one traveller, departing at 9:45 pm with check-in closing at 8:45 pm. Name the cabin class in the request.

retention_checks.check: The departure and check-in times are written as 21:45 and 20:45, with no 'pm'
